d: The 11 zone boundaries on the quadrant were reconstructed from the source chart’s visual layout and cross-checked against every developer’s reported (Credibility, Premiumness) coordinate — all 15 placements were consistent with their stated zone.

Anatomy dimension points follow each dimension’s published weight (Left Brain 15%, Heart 10%, Legs 15%, Right Brain 10%, Mouth 10%, Muscles 25%, Hands 15%) applied to the /10 score shown per developer.
The source infographic’s displayed weighted points for Mountain View sum to 73.5pt against dimension scores shown; the dashboard follows the report’s own displayed per-dimension values.

The stated total (75.5pt) differs from the sum of the individual weighted points shown (73.5pt) on the same page. The dashboard surfaces both the per-dimension detail and flags the gap rather than silently resolving it.

The displayed oval value for Hands (13.5pt) sits above what the 7/10 × 15% formula shown inline on the same page would produce (10.5pt). The oval (reported) value is used since it reconciles with the stated total.

The Ecosystem chart’s year labeling is ambiguous between a 2024 and 2025 reading for the most recent bar; both figures are referenced qualitatively in the Market Context tab rather than asserting one single value.
Emaar is the only developer in Section 05 whose Archetype the report leaves unconfirmed/open; it is shown as "Unconfirmed" rather than assigned.
Sales figures for Qatari Diar reflect a materially smaller operating base than the other 14 developers (flagged explicitly in the source as a comparability caveat).
"Hassan Allam" spans multiple related entities (construction, properties); brand perception data may partially blend association with the parent construction business.
